BrochureContent.Content:
This 3 bedroom detached bungalow is set on approximately 1.9 acres. The property offers a practical layout with a range of features, making it a well equipped home in a countryside setting.

The accommodation includes an entrance hallway leading to a sitting room with 9 ft ceilings, French pine flooring and a brick fireplace with under arch lighting. There is also a dining/living room with a Stanley range, which connects to a galley style kitchen fitted with glass blocks and under cabinet lighting.

The property has a master bedroom with ensuite, two additional bedrooms with built in wardrobes, and a fully tiled main bathroom with a Jacuzzi bath.

Additional features include oil-fired central heating, two Mira showers with priority units, a water softener and a water filtration system. TV and phone points are installed in each room, and the chimneys are flue lined with stainless steel.

Externally, the property has landscaped front and rear lawns and a patio area. The gardens are wired for outdoor lighting.

The property is accessed through a wrought-iron gate with brick pillars and lighting. Other outdoor features include water taps, night sensors and a post box at the entrance.

The house is fully alarmed and fitted with CCTV.
